camel_example: aliyun polardb BindResourceControl --region cn-hangzhou --TargetValue app_user --DBClusterId 'pc-00000000000000' --TargetType USER --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ResourceControlName test_rc
description_en: Binds a specified resource control rule to a user, database, query, or connection in a PolarDB for MySQL cluster. After the binding succeeds, the target object is subject to the CPU quota limit defined by the resource control rule
description_zh: 将指定的资源控制规则绑定到 PolarDB MySQL 集群中的用户、数据库、查询或连接。绑定成功后，目标对象将受到该资源控制规则的 CPU 配额限制
kebab_example: aliyun polardb bind-resource-control --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --resource-control-name test_rc --target-type USER --target-value app_user --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindResourceControl

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the PolarDB cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to query available regions
parameters.help_zh:
PolarDB 集群所在地域的 ID。

可通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html查看可用的地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource control rule. The name must be 1 to 63 ASCII bytes in length, start with a letter, and can contain only letters, digits, and underscores
parameters.help_zh: 资源控制规则名称。长度为 1～63 个 ASCII 字节，必须以英文字母开头，仅支持英文字母、数字和下划线
parameters.name: resource_control_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the binding target. Valid values: USER, DATABASE, QUERY, CONNECTION. The value is case-insensitive
parameters.help_zh: 绑定目标的类型。取值：USER、DATABASE、QUERY、CONNECTION，大小写不敏感
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en: The value of the binding target. The format depends on the value of TargetType. For more information, see the table below
parameters.help_zh: 绑定目标的值。具体格式由 TargetType 决定，参见下表
parameters.name: target_value
